sources.title: ltxv-gguf: Video-to-Video model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview ltxv-gguf is a collection of GGUF-quantized versions of LTX-Video, a 2-billion-parameter latent diffusion transformer for video generation. Maintained by calcuis, these quantized models enable efficient video synthesis on consumer hardware without the memory footprint of full-precision weights.
